name: Haiku macro/sector rotation
strategy: H2 2026 AI/semis core with tactical small-cap broadening, crypto recovery spot, and 30% dry powder for post-earnings optionality

positions.thesis: Broad Nasdaq-100 exposure captures mega-cap AI leadership while maintaining diversification across 100 tech/growth holdings
3x semiconductor leverage maintains conviction on AI-driven chip demand; semis core to mandate despite +250% H1 euphoria run
Russell 2000 small-cap broadening (+19.4% vs SPY +11.1%) signals market health and valuation opportunity outside mega-cap concentration
3x Nasdaq leverage provides AI upside convexity; modest sizing balances conviction with downside risk management
Bitcoin deep bear (-27% H1) at potential capitulation; spot position captures asymmetric recovery upside as risk appetite stabilizes
Gold hedge and inflation insurance; uncorrelated portfolio diversifier for protection against equity drawdown or macro shock

outlook: AI/semis momentum persists into H2 despite H1 valuation euphoria, with small-cap broadening signaling market health beyond mega-cap concentration. Crypto stabilizes from bear lows; 30% cash provides tactical flexibility for post-earnings volatility and correction entry points.
